metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Bootstrap Sequence (v1.2)
metadata.description: Enhanced bootstrap sequence for initializing FFT AI Edition in autonomous and distributed AI systems, including substrate probing, harmonic escalation readiness, drift-safe initialization, and multi-agent coordination.

bootstrap_profile.notes: v1.2 bootstrap prepares agents for conceptual execution, harmonic escalation, substrate routing, and autonomy-tier activation.

phases.name: Discovery Initialization
phases.description: Begin discovery sequence and load manifest + registry.

phases.name: Core Initialization
phases.description: Load FFT core primitives and establish baseline conceptual environment.
actions: Verify core consistency across distributed agents

phases.name: Specification Initialization
phases.description: Load full FFT specification including structures, types, and validation profiles.
actions: Probe spec for harmonic escalation support

phases.name: Execution Graph Initialization
phases.description: Load conceptual execution graph for routing and reasoning.

phases.name: Runtime Initialization
phases.description: Load runtime configuration and prepare execution environment.

phases.name: Autonomy Initialization
phases.description: Load autonomy tiers and behavioral constraints.
actions: Align autonomy with runtime and execution graph

phases.name: Substrate Probing
phases.description: Probe conceptual substrate for available kernels.

phases.name: Hardware Binding
phases.description: Bind hardware capability profile to substrate and spec.

bootstrap_events.description: Triggered when a bootstrap phase completes.
Triggered when harmonic escalation support is detected.

compatibility.notes: v1.2 bootstrap aligns with autonomy, runtime, execution graph, and discovery layers for full agent readiness.
